source_freeze_contract.policy: Exact complete 18-file source inventory, 15 correctness modules, immutable successful nine-job combined-source CI and independent whole-LM review references must be committed and verified before attempt claim. Source combines exactly L's ranked-entry representation and M's 97-scalar normalization translation on exact K. The rejected J hidden-rank route remains absent. Missing binding fails before evidence fetch, claim, download or retrieval.

derivation.policy: Retain the proven K/J2 separate correctness and measurement exports, complete guards and every original statistical/count/payload/data/helper/ABBA function. Replace only candidate/source/attempt/evidence identities and append the two exact new correctness modules. Preserve all original K/J controllers, scopes and results without edits.

prior_evidence: J2 retains its complete rejected result: 8,828 profile/paired calls, equal payloads, all eight timing cells adverse. K retains its complete below-target result: 4,096 paired calls, 2,048 equal payload pairs, zero adverse cells, GM p95 improvement 3.6355909620451876% and public native char4000 p95 improvement 3.085662287471702%; no formal acceptance. LM is a new whole combined source measured directly against released v032. No L/M component corpus measurements, cross-host pooling, added percentages or replay of unfavorable attempts.

correctness.criterion: Every fixture in the exact fifteen registered modules must run once with zero skips/failures/errors. Preserve all thirteen K modules and append tests.test_round5_ranked_entries and tests.test_round5_normalization_translation. No hardcoded fixture count can conceal omission.
correctness.environment: One ubuntu-24.04 / Python3.12 hosted VM; same pinned mcp1.30.0, pydantic2.14.3, tiktoken0.12.0 and regex2026.11.9 for both runtimes. Capture actual Python/SQLite/dependency/binary/tokenizer-cache identities before measurement.
correctness.isolation: First export the exact frozen LM source src/tests into a dedicated correctness directory and verify every frozen runtime/test file and runtime aggregate. Save started intent. Run the registered15-module suite once, retain every file afterward, capture added/missing/changed full source inventory and archive the complete correctness export losslessly. Missing/changed bound files or unknown added Python/non-bytecode files fail before measurement. Generated bytecode is explicitly recorded only in this never-measured directory; it is never deleted or excluded from the measurement guard.
correctness.measurement_export: After correctness and its saved inventory audit pass, independently export fresh exact baseline692fb and the frozen LM candidate src/tests into separate measurement directories. Recheck the complete file inventory, no symlinks and aggregate runtime SHA before profile and every paired stage. An extra pyc or unknown .py in either measurement export fails the complete guard. Never import or execute measurement helpers from the correctness export.
correctness.archive: Commit correctness-export.tar.gz and its full manifest/hash before corpus preparation. It contains only the repository source/tests and artificial fixture residue, never a downloaded development corpus or development DB. Preserve negative receipts and available partial files without retries.

data.policy: Only previously used old regression cohorts and exactly registered selections/seeds. No fresh selector, model, comparison engine or evaluator is invoked.

profile.method: Read only the nine exact small manifest/cell objects through git show; validate every compressed size/SHA256 and decompressed SHA256. Run one fresh candidate profile using the unchanged helper. Preserve original report bytes losslessly as gzip with raw and compressed hashes. Verify all eight cell axes, complete orders, dataset hashes and all 4732 full non-timing payload digests against saved v032/C2 references. Publish output and audit before paired timing; any incomplete profile or mismatch stops the paired phase.
profile.preservation: All instrumented profiler rows and negative outcomes remain present. Summary profile times identify code paths only; no historical profile latency or profiler time is used to infer speed.

snapshots: Before profile/timing, build each new paired source database exactly once with released v032 and the frozen old loader. Record immutable DB bytes, sizes, logical table digests and query selection. Both runtimes copy those same snapshots to unique worker directories; the profile helper independently creates its own candidate databases, exactly as before. No historical database hash is substituted, no completed worker DB is reused. Controller allocation during snapshot hashing is not a formal memory-resource measurement.

paired.query_selection: Same 128 old IDs per cohort; independently recompute selection and require equality with the frozen original binding.
paired.query_order: random.Random(91261 + round*1009 + configuration_index).shuffle; original AB/BA order.
paired.audit: All eight workers, 4096 observations, 2048 full non-timing payload pairs, exact query/configuration order, finite timings, per-round and pooled p50/p95/mean, p95 geometric change, and every cell whose p50 or p95 regresses beyond5%. No selection of favorable repetitions.

durability.policy: Only run_attempt1 on the exact trigger; reject existing result/state. Before claim verify the frozen LM source binding, exact inherited K driver/scope, successful complete combined-source CI, independent LM source review, K below-target evidence and preserved J rejection. Preserve correctness intent/outcome/archive, fresh source inventories, new DB binding, profile intent/output/audit and every worker intent/result in verified remote commits. No automatic measurement or publication retry.
durability.publication: Non-force expected-head verification. After one push verify exact new remote commit. On refusal or ambiguity, stop without automatic retry; retain failure marker and artifacts. No source database or corpus plaintext is published.
durability.failure: Keep all original receipts, failed/incomplete stages, available cell-granularity partial JSON and logs. Gzip conversion is lossless with exact uncompressed checksum. Workflow always preservation never invokes retrieval or replays a stage.

formal_and_release: No original numerical threshold is changed: the14-cell/66248-call formal performance requirements, full-payload contracts, resource review, historical lexical/Q2 compatibility, planned fresh quality validation and release verification remain separate mandatory steps. This development run alone cannot certify release readiness or competitor superiority.
authoring_policy: First commit this prospective development scope. Commit the controller and artificial fixtures independently of the final source binding. Freeze the exact source/evidence binding only after complete combined-source CI and independent review. Staging pushes may run artificial CI only. Only root may create the separate measurement trigger; the final launch-ready commit must not contain a skip-ci directive.
